reference_tables.title: Yuri

description.menu: Cow-hide with steel-plated knuckles.
description.text: Leather gloves for punching. Damages enemy while providing protection. Ideal for fighters.

description.menu: Made of a hard black steel and used for punching.
description.text: This handheld weapon has sharp blades affixed to it allowing for slashing as well. It is made of a powerful black steel and is easily carried.

description.menu: Lethal weapon designed to pierce armor.
description.text: A favored weapon among Eastern assassins. Its unusually long blade and frightening appearance make it a weapon to be feared.

description.menu: Ninja stabbing weapon with double sides.
description.text: An ancient weapon, the middle finger passes through a ring and it is clutched in the fist. When mastered, it can be used to block an enemy's sword.

description.menu: Well-crafted metal knuckles, useful for brawlers.
description.text: The dream of any rough-and-tumble brawler, they are made of hand-forged brass and can raise the user's punching power enormously.

description.menu: Holy silver claws that are easy to use.
description.text: Silver claws gripped between the fingers. Easy to use and accurate due to their light weight. An excellent weapon for the powerful fighter-type. Very valuable.

description.menu: Made from the enchanted fang of a wolf king.
description.text: A weapon created from the fang of the wolf king, Vadelg. It is said to hold great power but no details are known because it has never been found.

description.menu: Used by an ancient war god in magic-sealing.
description.text: This weapon was said to have been used in ancient days by the god of war and that its wielder can summon the power of Ashura. Its true origin is a mystery.

reference_tables.intro: Listed here are all of the weapons in the game, in order of character recruited, followed by weakest to strongest.

description.menu: Written on sheepskin, it holds great power.
description.text: Sheepskin engraved bible containing the written word of God. Its holy power may be discovered only by the true believer.

description.menu: Superb manuscript about a fabled continent.
description.title: Tome of the Shooting Star
description.text: Antique book about a fabled continent that sank into the sea beneath a falling star. Lovingly transcribed from the original and very valuable.

description.menu: Black velvet book with details about magic arts.
description.text: Ancient book of Magic encased in a black velvet cover. It is written with elegant calligraphy and embossed in gold leaf.

description.menu: Book of anti-magic to counter Tome of the Moon.
description.text: Ancient book of curse removal and magic-blocking. Extremely difficult to read, but legends say if done so with a pure heart, it can redeem an entire nation.

description.menu: Holy book embedded with shining blue crystals.
description.text: Ancient, holy book embedded with shining blue crystals. Necessary for performing an exorcism ritual on a possessed woman.

description.menu: Holy book of prophesy with great spiritual power.
description.text: Only the greatest of holy leaders my possess this book of prophesy. The book itself carries great mystical power.

description.menu: Ancient book stained with the blood of martyrs.
description.title: Holy Book of the Martyrs
description.text: Holy book stained with the blood of martyrs who labored for countless years in service against the forces of evil. Strong spiritual power.

description.menu: Holy book made from the flesh of a saint.
description.title: Holy Book of Flesh
description.text: After the death of Rafaelo, his flesh was used to make this book. To a good person it can bring blessings, but to others it may open the very doors of hell.

description.menu: Made from ancient oak, it enhances magic powers.
description.text: Staff made from the limb of an ancient oak. It raises a magic wielder's abilities and is a necessary step on the way to becoming an Adept in the Taoist Arts.

description.menu: Heavy metal staff capable of great destruction.
description.text: Metal rod. Heavy and destructive, it is perfect for the adventuring clergyman. The accumulated experience of many a holy man lies within the staff itself.

description.menu: Carved from a sacred tree. Light and strong.
description.text: Staff carved from a sacred tree. Given its light weight and strength, it is an ideal weapon for older adventurers.

description.menu: Staff for outdoor adventurers. A powerful weapon.
description.text: Staff of a hermit who explored the wild regions of the continent. Its scarlet color is said to be the hermit's own blood. A valuable and powerful weapon.

description.menu: Staff of the Oracle with special attack powers.
description.text: This staff can only be held by the most dedicated of Oracles. It is said to bring calamity upon those unworthy to wield it. Tremendous attack power.

description.menu: Holy Staff. Few can master its powers.
description.title: Four Gods' Staff
description.text: Staff blessed by the spirit of Mitama. In the hands of a master, the staff itself is said to become sentient. Very few can tap into its true power.

description.menu: Contains the soul of an actual Taoist Adept.
description.text: Before his death, a powerful Taoist Adept transferred his soul into this staff. In the hands of a fellow Adept, it is a weapon of extreme power.

description.menu: Holy staff. Grants wielder incalculable power.
description.text: Legendary holy staff. It is claimed that whoever wields it will have the power to control Heaven and Earth.

description.menu: Lightweight machine gun. Perfect for spies.
description.text: Easy to carry, semi-automatic pistol. Not very powerful or accurate but a good weapon in the right hands.

description.menu: 8 mm automatic; Can cause Confusion
description.text: 8 millimeter radius, 8-shot automatic. Extremely well balanced and easy to use, but must be used with caution due to its light trigger. Also causes Confusion.

description.menu: Improved version of the Type 94. Very accurate.
description.text: Automatic handgun with a unique rounded trigger guard. Improved version of the Type 94 with small recoil and very high accuracy.

description.menu: Mid-sized machinegun with unmatched balance.
description.text: The most perfectly balanced of all 9 mm portable machineguns. Extremely reliable with a low malfunction rate.

description.menu: New model of popular machinegun. High attack.
description.text: The machinegun, manufactured by a well-respected gunmaker, is unrivalled in terms of its lightweight design. Very expensive, but well worth the price.

description.menu: Shotgun with massive stopping power.
description.text: Sawed-off, 12 gauge riot gun with unsurpassed stopping power. Its intimidating appearance and powerful report strike fear into enemies.

description.menu: Prototype with improved firing speed and power.
description.text: Rapid firing, machinegun prototype. Uses 9 mm Parabellum bullets. Its unique wooden stock can be fixed to the ground as a base. Heavy but incredibly powerful.

description.menu: Rifle well-known for its excellent performance.
description.text: Many brave warriors owe their survival to this weapon. It excels both in firepower and special attack. Its previous owner's names are inscribed on its stock.

description.menu: Well-preserved antique sword with engraved blade.
description.text: This sword has been stained with the blood of many swordsmen. Its blade is a unique combination of flexibility and durability. It can cause Instant Death.

description.menu: Thrusting sword favored by nobles for jousting.
description.text: A long sword favored by nobles for jousting. Its narrow tip was made for piercing armor. Somewhat heavy to be carried, it is a weapon to be feared in battle.

description.menu: Holy silver sword with special attack power.
description.title: Silver Crescent Sword
description.text: Crescent shaped blade forged from blessed silver. Shorter than other words, but its appearance has a tendency to make enemies falter.

description.menu: Enchanted sword. Turns wielder into a killer.
description.title: Sword of the Berserker
description.text: Sword formerly owned by the cursed knight, Brom. Causes wielder to transform into a butcher. Its blade is said to main and give off light in combat. NOTE As far as I know, you cannot obtain this sword anywhere in-game.

description.menu: Enormous executioner's sword used for beheading.
description.title: Executioner's Sword
description.text: Massive sword used for beheading. Its blade is so sharp that it could easily slice a horse in two. Enormous strength is needed to wield it in battle.

description.menu: Razor-like blade gives off a ghostly essence.
description.text: Cursed after shedding the blood of countless witches, this razor-like blade gives off a ghostly essence and can cause Instant Death.

description.menu: Spirit blade used by the Darkness Clan.
description.title: Vampire-blade, Blodauth
description.text: Passed down for hundreds of years among the Darkness Clan, it carries a power so great that no other can hold it. Its power is truly incredible.

description.menu: Demonic sword and family heirloom.
description.title: Demon Sword, Tyrving
description.text: Legendary Demon Sword that can only be wielded by the highest ranking member of the Darkness Clan. It is rumored to have the power to even slay the Undead.

description.menu: Hurls steel ball bearings but with poor accuracy.
description.text: Powerful slingshot which hurls steel balls with great force. Somewhat inaccurate, it requires much training before it becomes truly effective.

description.menu: Wooden slingshot. High attack power.
description.text: Make from oak wood, it hurls metal balls with incredible force. Also causes Poison.

description.menu: Made from laurel wood and imbued with spirit power.
description.text: Made from the wood of an ancient, holy laurel tree, it has the power to cause Silence. It doesn't look like much, but is a very powerful weapon in battle.

description.menu: Slingshot favored by hunters. High attack power.
description.text: Due to its powerful pull, it requires great hand strength and causes tremendous damage even against enemies with strong defense. May cause Paralysis.

description.menu: Wickedly enchanted weapon. Possessed.
description.title: Improved Slingshot
description.text: A slingshot was used to create this twisted weapon. It causes great damage and even Petrification. It contains the tortured soul of a small child.

description.menu: Indestructible, high performance slingshot.
description.title: High Allow Slingshot
description.text: This super high alloy slingshot is as unique as it is powerful. Superbly engraved on it is the slogan "Sic Semper Tyrannis".

description.menu: Invented by the greatest archer, William Tell.
description.text: Slingshot said to have been invented by the archer, William Tell, in his later years. One of only a few in the world, it is unsurpassed in accuracy and power.

description.menu: New weapon invented by a phony alchemist. Very high performance.
description.text: A weapon invented by an alchemist called Skin of Teeth. It's shape and power are very unique. It strikes fear into enemies.
